title: La prórroga
goal: Extend a visa and be sent away twice first
culture: Thirty days at a time, and never all of the requirements at once. Ask ¿qué más? until the answer is nada, or you will find out about the third item on your second trip.

beats.good: La prórroga is the extension. Say the word for the thing and you skip ten minutes of explaining what you mean.
Thirty at a time is what they give, so thirty is what you ask for.

beats.es: Necesito copia del pasaporte y dos fotos.
beats.good: Ask it until the answer is nada. Otherwise the third requirement turns up on your second trip, which is how it is designed.

beats.es: Y el comprobante del pago. Nada más.
beats.objective: Say you will be straight back
beats.en: I’ll be back with the photos.
beats.good: Ya vengo — back in a moment, said about anything from a minute to an afternoon. The photo place is the one you already used in El Centro.
